target.statement: Silhouette score of 0.191 for k-means clustering on TDA-derived features (Wasserstein distance matrix embedded via MDS) for 13 currencies using monthly log-returns from 2000-01-13 to 2022-03-01.
target.dataset: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates for 13 currencies (AUD, BRL, CHF, CNY, GBP, INR, JPY, KRW, RUB, THB, TRY, USD, ZAR) against EUR, monthly log-returns, Jan 2000 - Mar 2022 (266 monthly observations).

compute.basis: Data is freely available from ECB; TDA computations (Vietoris-Rips on ~260 points per currency, 13 currencies) are small and CPU-friendly, but no code is provided, so the agent must implement the full pipeline (sliding-window embedding, persistent homology, Wasserstein distances, MDS, k-means) from scratch, which is the main time cost.

blockers: No code or configuration files provided; full pipeline must be reimplemented from the paper's description.
Some methodological details (e.g., exact MDS settings, Wasserstein computation parameters) are not fully specified, requiring reasonable choices that may affect the exact score.
title: Topology of Currencies: Persistent Homology for FX Co-movements: A Comparative Clustering Study
